snippet.title: Backwatt — Official Trailer | Co-op Roguelite with Backpack Power Grids | Free Demo on Steam
snippet.description:
Pack your rig with guns, wire it to power, and survive the robot swarm — solo or with up to 4 friends.

Backwatt is a top-down co-op arena roguelite where your backpack is your build. Every item sits in a grid: generators feed weapons, neighbors boost each other, and how you wire your rig decides whether your squad makes it to the drop ship.

▶ Wishlist to get notified on launch

FEATURES
• Backpack power grid — place, merge and wire items; adjacency and power define your build
• Online co-op for up to 4 players (or play solo)
• 6 heroes, each with their own rig, passives and skill tree
• 4 seasonal acts, 16 robot enemy types and bosses with their own tricks
• Endless mode for when one run isn't enough
• Between waves: your ship's hold — armory, shooting range, and the ramp back into the fight

#Backwatt #roguelite #coop #indiegame #inventorymanagement
